query: Who won the June 2025 South Korean presidential election?
answer:
Lee Jae-myung of the Democratic Party of Korea won the snap presidential election held on June 3, 2025 [1][2]. He took 49.42% of the vote. His main rival, Kim Moon-soo of the People Power Party, got 41.15%, and Lee Jun-seok of the New Reform Party got 8.34% [1][3]. Lee's 17.29 million votes were the most any candidate has received in a South Korean presidential election. Turnout was 79.38%, the highest since 1997 [1]. The election was called early because Yoon Suk Yeol was impeached and removed from office. Lee was sworn in the next day without the usual transition period, three years after he narrowly lost the 2022 election to Yoon [1][2].

One search snippet said Lee lost 47.8% to 48.6%. Those are the 2022 numbers, not the 2025 ones.
